name: pathly
description: A runnable heartbeat for the Pathly mobile app and API.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,mobile --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @pathly/api" "npm run dev --workspace @pathly/mobile"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @pathly/api" "npm run web --workspace @pathly/mobile"
scripts.dev:ios: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,ios --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @pathly/api" "npm run ios --workspace @pathly/mobile"
scripts.dev:android: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,android --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @pathly/api" "npm run android --workspace @pathly/mobile"
